👉 Recent polling shows I’m statistically tied with Rogers.

👉 And the chair of the NRSC went on national TV to say turning Michigan red is their best chance to hold the Senate.
**He literally said: “We are going to win in Michigan.”**
This is what we’re up against, null. These Republicans think they’ve already won because their megadonors are ready to spend big.
**They’re counting on grassroots supporters sitting this one out. With our first FEC deadline of 2026 coming up TOMORROW, we have a chance to prove them wrong. But I need your help.**

NYT: Trump Leans on Congress to Address His False Claims of Voter Fraud [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=033026_4&amount=25]
President Trump used his recent State of the Union address and the DHS funding debate to press Congress to advance stalled legislation that purports to address his often-repeated -- and equally debunked -- claims of widespread election fraud. There are stats from the conservative, right-wing Heritage Foundation below that prove it.
The SAVE America Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights and passed the U.S. House of Representatives. Now Trump and his MAGA minions are meeting with U.S. Senators, scheming for ways to get this bill through the Senate ahead of November's midterms.
This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law, folks.
PITCH IN $35 RIGHT NOW TO STOP THE SAVE AMERICA ACT NOW ➜ [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=033026_4&amount=35]
Don’t be fooled by the name. This bill would force every voter to present specific types of proof of citizenship to register -- something millions of eligible Americans don’t have on hand. And that’s the point. The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise up to 11 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”

subject: Stick It, Texas. You're Not Getting Our Oil.
body:

| | | | | | Texas is coming for New Mexico's oil counties. Not joking — the Texas House Speaker put it on his official agenda this week.

[**Mark has two words for them.**](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=0524ccb2b0&e=567664f14c)

| |
🔥 **TEXAS HOUSE SPEAKER MOVES TO ANNEX NM'S OIL COUNTIES — MARK FIRES BACK**
Dustin Burrows directed a Texas House committee to study the legal process of pulling Lea County — and possibly more — into Texas.
Mark breaks down every hurdle standing in the way. Both legislatures, Congress, a public vote, and a state that funds half its budget from those counties.
🚨 **DUKE RODRIGUEZ DISMISSES VETERAN JOURNALIST — KRYSTY'S RESPONSE IS FIRE**
A KRQE journalist asked the one question everyone wants answered. Instead of responding, Duke implied her husband was feeding her the questions.
Krysty went off in response. And then Mark reveals something about Duke's donor history that makes the residency issue look like a footnote.
When you see where his money went, you'll understand why the other candidates haven't touched him yet.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=2e15b90377&e=567664f14c)
---
| |
🛡️ **DEMOCRATS BLOCK DHS FUNDING — 700 IRANIANS RELEASED INTO THE COUNTRY**
TSA agents are quitting. Airport lines are stretching through terminals. And the media is trying to blame Republicans for a shutdown that requires 60 Senate votes to fix.
Tom Homan went on Face the Nation. The anchor tried the usual trick. Watch how that went.
Then we get into a number from the border that should be leading every newscast in America. It's not.

⚠️ **PENTAGON PREPARING BOOTS ON THE GROUND IN IRAN — HOW LONG IS TOO LONG?**
Reports say 10,000 troops could be heading to the Middle East. Senator Lankford went on Meet the Press and laid out what has to happen before we commit.
Mark has a warning about the political clock on this — and a timeline where it goes from manageable to very dangerous for the White House.
---

This is what governing looks like...when you don't know how to do it 😬 Peter,

Congressional Republicans are breaking records...but for all the wrong reasons.

The GOP-led House is paralyzed, leaving critical departments shut down, bills stalled, and hardworking Americans left holding the bag.

Under Speaker Mike Johnson, **this Congress has set a record for the fewest roll-call votes in decades, blocked amendments to legislation at historic levels, and avoided votes on bills that actually have majority support.**

In short: _they're not governing—they're stalling, posturing, and letting dysfunction run wild._

Meanwhile, essential programs and agencies like the Department of Homeland Security are stuck in a shutdown, while Republicans cling to procedural games instead of solving real problems. Every single day, their lack of leadership costs families, workers, and communities across the country their financial freedom, their livelihoods, their basic rights, and so much more.

We need to seize the moment, Peter. Young people who voted for Trump were sick of the status quo, but they are not happy with what’s happening now. We can win them back, but we have to fight for real change, _not more empty promises._
Our work is giving young people a new generation of leaders to vote for, and it’s working.
But here’s the truth: **We can’t keep up this work without your support.**

### The NEA's Free Ride Just Got Closer to Ending
Mar 31
---

---
| | | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2114823&post_id=192690802&utm_source=substack&isFreemail=true&submitLike=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTkyNjkwODAyLCJyZWFjdGlvbiI6IuKdpCIsImlhdCI6MTc3NDkzMjA3MSwiZXhwIjoxNzc3NTI0MDcxLCJpc3MiOiJwdWItMjExNDgyMyIsInN1YiI6InJlYWN0aW9uIn0.c-48_Uo7PIqKQPKCJ2CRYID_NB8QM6voQitMVIx2jk8&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email-reaction&r=1hvr60)

| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/brianlenney/p/no-more-taxpayer-money-to-teachers?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Three years...
That's how long we've been fighting to end taxpayer-funded subsidies to teachers unions in Idaho. And tonight, we broke through.
_Because Idaho taxpayers have been funding an organization that actively works against them (and most people have no idea)._
Teachers unions collect dues and those dues flow to the NEA in Washington D.C. $4.4 million collected through Idaho school district payroll systems every year. About $1.1 million goes straight to NEA headquarters.
What does the NEA do with Idaho's money?
They push radical curriculum and fight school choice (and they're winning in a lot of states). They protect bad teachers from being fired, bankroll politicians who couldn't survive a primary in rural Idaho, and they sued to keep schools closed during COVID while private schools stayed open and kids fell behind. Gender ideology in elementary classrooms? That's them. And when parents ask what's being taught to their own kids, the NEA treats them like threats.
The [Wall Street Journal editorial board](https://substack.com/redirect/97100ab6-8614-4c89-9539-55652b1bd3a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) called the NEA _" the ideological and institutional vanguard of progressive politics"_ and _" a powerful wing of the Democratic Party."_
And Idaho taxpayers have been helping fund all of it.
Because when dues get pulled from a teacher's paycheck, state employees on state time process that transaction. Which means that Idaho taxpayer dollars are doing administrative work for a political machine that hates everything most Idahoans believe in.
For example...
Boise School District has a "professional activities" stipend that matches IEA dues almost exactly (over $1 million per year in taxpayer-funded union membership laundered through payroll).
Or, did you know that fifty-one school district contracts pay teachers to leave classrooms and do union work on the clock. In Payette, the contract explicitly covers "testifying on legislative initiatives." Yes, we're paying teachers to lobby us at the capitol with our money!
_**H 516 ends all of it.**_
But here's what should make you furious: we had a bill ready to address all of this and more. It passed the house and even though a senator promised a hearing (and sponsored the original bill himself), he stuck it in his desk drawer. That's how you kill a bill without a vote. All because he made some a deal with the unions!
So tonight, we went around him.
Took the teachers union language, radiator capped it onto a bill already moving through the Senate, and passed it out of amending order. Rare move. But it worked (Radiator capping is when you gut a bill that's already in motion, replace the contents with your new language. Bill number stays the same. Same cap, new engine underneath.)
Now we're just one vote away from ending this for good (it still needs to clear the full Senate, then land on the governor's desk).
As you know...
President Trump just came out swinging on education. Shutting down the federal Department of Education. Calling teachers unions the enemy of American parents. Trump calls teachers unions a cancer on American education every week (seems like the whole Republican Party is moving this direction).
If you live in Idaho, this is the moment.
**Contact your** _**Republican**_**senators and Governor Little.**
Tell them H 516 better pass. And it better get signed. No more taxpayer money funding people fighting against Idaho parents and kids.
We're close. Don't let up.

| Team, it's Marni von Wilpert. The Voter Protection Project said I could reach out with a MAJOR update in our race.

Republicans are changing tactics in this race, swapping Rep. Darrell Issa with far-right San Diego County Supervisor Jim Desmond. But swapping one MAGA loyalist for another doesn’t change a thing.

**[Split a donation now between the Voter Protection Project and me to help me flip CA-48, no matter the opponent. »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/105923?t=6&akid=23420%2E878179%2EkarbF9)**

Here’s what to know about MAGA Republican Jim Desmond:

❌ He is full MAGA, with the backing of Trump’s Republican Party.

❌ He is a longtime backer of Trump’s ICE attacks against immigrants and our communities, even siding with Trump's lawsuit against California for protecting immigrants in 2018. **_Donald Trump thanked him for his efforts._**

❌ He voted for a massive pay increase for politicians like himself who already make _**over $200,000 a year,**_ and used a special slush fund to spend **_a quarter of a million taxpayer dollars_** on lavish office redecorations for himself.

❌ He is backed by the extremist gun lobby and opposes common-sense gun regulations to reduce gun violence and school shootings.

❌ He voted to allow big tobacco companies to sell candy-flavored vaping products designed to hook children, which have increased teen smoking by _**900%.**_

❌ He is a danger to public health in the spitting image of RFK Jr. — he was called San Diego’s ‘most high-profile skeptic of the coronavirus’ for his work to discredit scientists, and _**even claimed COVID wasn’t really killing people.**_

If Republicans think they can trick voters by playing musical chairs with candidates, they have another thing coming. **Voters know better.** This district is ready to flip, and no last-minute, desperate Republican reshuffling is going to change that.

I’m running to take back Congress, stop Trump’s chaos, and make Washington work for working people again. I’ve beaten Republicans, the NRA gun lobby, and opioid drug companies, and I’m ready to beat whatever handpicked Trump puppet the GOP throws at me, but I need your help, friend.

body:
Getting rid of Carpetbagger Boebert should be a top priority for redistricting in Colorado.
| | | | | [](https://6s79z9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001AHExPkoRlXYj96eEuUj9kdauYrGBYBOMv0jgjDlsRLhvnWqK-64BwIUB4iL9KUh8aXXBl6xcAHnS2puu21DSQvI8ZAp78ZmMRk98qv5HZOliBZtjDCVWkHuo1r2XLazw_5O9lpetNSeR5UAo6R9VR__tgj4YK85y9BrBfEf9WFPYt7c0t_HSCLIwRVSq8i55RlxM6mJqeo3pS-B3sYmzduCLyJ4S1IsI&c=Di4Wf67Q7FfHPPg9JCq-BBmsvAMv_kvhHqAJzrXhwcsh3ZJrsNjVXA==&ch=G0zWybHWp7I4H25vMWDTKfSrRD3TMvRAx-ot-RUQ_XkdqhFdvdT03Q==)
---
Peter,
Lauren Boebert is a national disgrace.
In addition to being a constant embarrassment for Colorado during her time in Congress, Boebert has proven herself to be one of MAGA's loudest and most loyal foot soldiers.
And she only is still in Congress because she carpetbagged her way from one side of the state to the other to replace the independent-minded Rep. Ken Buck, who retired in 2024.
Boebert underperformed Donald Trump last year by 7 points. Her name ID in the state and in this district is virtually 100% -- everyone knows about Lauren Boebert, her gross scandals (think the Beetlejuice theater incident), and her constant terrible headlines.
We don't need to redraw Boebert's district specifically to see her defeated. Voters are ready to get rid of Lauren Boebert. A Democrat can win in this district, and has won it recently.
But if our ballot measure campaign to redistrict blue state Colorado is approved the current district lines will change, forcing Boebert to carpetbag to unfamiliar territory yet again. And the list of Republicans lining up to take her on in a primary campaign will get long real fast.
Our work could bring about the end of Boebert's pathetic career in public office.
---
| [](https://6s79z9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001AHExPkoRlXYj96eEuUj9kdauYrGBYBOMv0jgjDlsRLhvnWqK-64BwIUB4iL9KUh8aXXBl6xcAHnS2puu21DSQvI8ZAp78ZmMRk98qv5HZOliBZtjDCVWkHuo1r2XLazw_5O9lpetNSeR5UAo6R9VR__tgj4YK85y9BrBfEf9WFPYt7c0t_HSCLIwRVSq8i55RlxM6mJqeo0gaHZnKcJyJKhrEWkpiyQS&c=Di4Wf67Q7FfHPPg9JCq-BBmsvAMv_kvhHqAJzrXhwcsh3ZJrsNjVXA==&ch=G0zWybHWp7I4H25vMWDTKfSrRD3TMvRAx-ot-RUQ_XkdqhFdvdT03Q==)
---
That map of Colorado above could instead show 7 Democrats, 1 Republican -- or even all 8 seats swinging to Democrats in a blue wave year.
We can achieve this, but time is running out. We have limited time left to gather the signatures we need (200,000 from all 35 state senate districts) to get our plan on the ballot for voters to approve.

body:
A moment that stopped me cold wasn't the woman handing out cash. It wasn't the homeless man who had no idea what he was signing. It wasn't even the

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zci6gjhvaivcu8crqf908v1gsf91ih0haig1ua4g_rp22sh2s8i6epr1cjhm0oj2clh2bs "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-cash-for-sigs-2-hf?utm_source=omg-cash-for-sigs-2&utm_medium=hf&utm_campaign=20260331&utm_content=aan&amount=25")

| Dear Friend,
A moment that stopped me cold wasn't the woman handing out cash. It wasn't the homeless man who had no idea what he was signing. It wasn't even the petitioner who followed my producer down the street threatening to **"knock him out."** It was the cop. Officer Maraveilla of the LAPD was sitting right there -- **feet away from 28 documented instances of federal election fraud** -- watching people exchange cash for voter registrations in broad daylight. And when we asked him about it, here's what he said: **"I mean, if it's nonprofit... they're signing it. It's consensual. It's more of a civil thing -- like they're not telling them no."** That's the officer assigned to Skid Row every single day. He doesn't know the California law. He doesn't know the federal statute. He watched a federal felony happen in front of him and called it a contractual dispute. **[**This is why we exist.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq8hq931566ebf8almomu60tqed604t2ee8lcpto_rp22sh2s8i6epr1cjhm0oj2clh2bs "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-cash-for-sigs-2-hf?utm_source=omg-cash-for-sigs-2&utm_medium=hf&utm_campaign=20260331&utm_content=aan&amount=35")** [****](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvrcm6bkbt8qu90uq7548p00sthfetnvb22cv07o_rp22sh2s8i6epr1cjhm0oj2clh2bs "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-cash-for-sigs-2-hf?utm_source=omg-cash-for-sigs-2&utm_medium=hf&utm_campaign=20260331&utm_content=aan&amount=25") **[-> Stand with us -- donate $35 right now to keep this investigation running](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztul7mkn9qncslm0ctut929anq6i4oltmald4qn0_rp22sh2s8i6epr1cjhm0oj2clh2bs "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-cash-for-sigs-2-hf?utm_source=omg-cash-for-sigs-2&utm_medium=hf&utm_campaign=20260331&utm_content=aan&amount=25")** **Here's what makes that even more outrageous:** This is not new behavior on Skid Row. In 2019, **nine individuals were prosecuted by the Los Angeles DA for this exact crime** -- exchanging cigarettes and cash for petition signatures. Fourteen counts. Same California Elections Code §18603\. Same Skid Row. But here's the critical difference: **none of it was on video.** Not one second of footage. It was word against word, and the prosecutions went nowhere that mattered. This time, we have everything on tape. We have **28 documented exchanges on hidden camera**. We have Brenda Brown's face. We have her saying, **"I'm paying you guys. I need to get paid too."** We have the petitioner's pyramid scheme explained in their own words. We have the Weingart Center employee directing our journalist to where the fraud was happening. We have the LASA worker who falsely identified himself as LAPD to try to stop us. And now we have the cop who looked at all of it and said: **"civil matter."** **[-> $75 funds one full day of undercover fieldwork -- donate now](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkfhteq5jbtchvsbi7to6in8nul69u23ojct6bfo_rp22sh2s8i6epr1cjhm0oj2clh2bs "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-cash-for-sigs-2-hf?utm_source=omg-cash-for-sigs-2&utm_medium=hf&utm_campaign=20260331&utm_content=aan&amount=25")** My team paid a price for this footage. When our undercover journalist kept asking questions, one of the petitioners followed him and threatened -- on camera -- to **"move him down the street,"** then: **"I'll knock you out looking right at me. Don't come over here again. I'mma beat your ass."** He didn't back down. He stayed in the field. He got the footage. **That kind of courage doesn't come cheap, and it doesn't happen without your financial support.** **[-> Donate $150 -- cover the secure equipment one journalist carries into the field](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8kiljn8kj2jpivd9e1a488vfteiiqujj7a98dlo_rp22sh2s8i6epr1cjhm0oj2clh2bs "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-cash-for-sigs-2-hf?utm_source=omg-cash-for-sigs-2&utm_medium=hf&utm_campaign=20260331&utm_content=aan&amount=25")** **Here's where we stand right now:** Part I forced official responses from the Governor's office, the U.S. Attorney, the LA DA's Public Integrity Division, the California Secretary of State, the White House, and President Trump himself. Part II revealed homeless people being handed **printed lists of real voters' names and instructed to forge their signatures** -- potentially thousands of times across Los Angeles. This new clip adds the final, damning layer: **law enforcement on scene had no idea this was even illegal**. The system that was supposed to catch this fraud wasn't watching. **We were.** We still are. And we need $18,300 to fully cover the cost of getting this investigation to the finish line. Part III is in production right now. **[-> DONATE NOW -- help us raise the $18,300 needed to complete this investigation](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztro7bfqab5f911rijimts87i59edsuhf4ed6no8_rp22sh2s8i6epr1cjhm0oj2clh2bs "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-cash-for-sigs-2-hf?utm_source=omg-cash-for-sigs-2&utm_medium=hf&utm_campaign=20260331&utm_content=aan&amount=25")** **FROM THE NEW TAPE -- IN THEIR OWN WORDS:** [0:00] -- Petitioner on camera, cash in hand: **"$2. We going to give you $2. We just need 14 signatures."** [0:37] -- James O'Keefe: "That is a federal felony. Whoever knowingly or willfully pays or offers to pay or accepts payment for registration to vote shall be fined not more than $10,000 and imprisoned not more than five years." [1:00] -- James O'Keefe: **"It didn't just happen once. It happened over and over and over again. We personally witnessed and covertly filmed this happening at least 28 times -- and that is just in Los Angeles."** [1:11] -- Petitioner threatening OMG journalist: **"Go down the street, bro, before we move you down the street. I'll knock you out looking right at me. I'mma beat your ass."** [1:49] -- James O'Keefe: "We found it particularly ironic that two police officers sitting nearby weren't even aware that this was a state or federal crime." [2:04] -- Officer Maraveilla, LAPD, on camera: **"I mean, if it's nonprofit... they're signing it. It's consensual. It's more of a civil thing. Maybe if they promise them something and they don't get it, it would be like a civil lawsuit kind of thing."** [2:24] -- James O'Keefe: "The law enforcement officers sitting nearby on Skid Row every single day don't know the California laws and plead ignorance. It begs the question -- what are they even doing?" In 2019, this same crime was prosecuted with no video. Fourteen counts. The cases were weak because there was no proof. Today, we have proof. **The only question is whether we have the resources to see it through.** **[-> YES -- Here is my gift to fund the fight for election integrity](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z08h5datr3qt9lp61pde58v3ue9lef3f853u2rhg_rp22sh2s8i6epr1cjhm0oj2clh2bs "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-cash-for-sigs-2-hf?utm_source=omg-cash-for-sigs-2&utm_medium=hf&utm_campaign=20260331&utm_content=aan&amount=25")** In Truth,
James O'Keefe
Founder and CEO
O'Keefe Media Group
**P.S.** -- Officer Maraveilla watched people hand over cash for voter registrations right in front of him. He called it "a civil thing." That officer is still on duty in Skid Row today. The only people who caught this on tape are us. **[**Please give what you can so we can finish what we started.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zblki0a8mveubt1i7vdj4to6lu6d4l00j9hrqen8_rp22sh2s8i6epr1cjhm0oj2clh2bs "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-cash-for-sigs-2-hf?utm_source=omg-cash-for-sigs-2&utm_medium=hf&utm_campaign=20260331&utm_content=aan&amount=25")** **P.P.S.** -- In 2019 they had 14 counts and no video. This time we have video -- 28 documented exchanges -- and the DOJ, the LA DA, the Governor's office, and the White House have all been put on notice. **Part III drops soon.** **[**Don't let this investigation stall for lack of funding.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zibjafeihrplkia68ristrskfqn0sco68ihhknkg_rp22sh2s8i6epr1cjhm0oj2clh2bs "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-cash-for-sigs-2-hf?utm_source=omg-cash-for-sigs-2&utm_medium=hf&utm_campaign=20260331&utm_content=aan&amount=25")**

Part II revealed homeless people being handed printed lists of real voters' names and instructed to forge their signatures -- potentially thousands of times across Los Angeles. Hundreds of Navy SEALs, Army Rangers, and other special operations forces have quietly arrived in the Middle East, joining thousands of Marines and 82nd Airborne paratroopers, giving the president [military options, including ground raids](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD3unDAUxE9jOiNjG1gKF2noNm1K9LAfixN_IPvtIm4fsVf4dyPNaDTz-_NcnuCDT6_fENHQlpeEZw1IhGWh8o4H7QWBMFUgAvtPRZ_eixRy4EJx1S0OfLgW3TizIUpUDZpuHPXUd6Mamt1MduytnnBce9EpvdnVKlDSiXGd1ofFxpu7TSjVdUI8et26FVTfu2mbOoDBaqYFOk-5tH-zT7TjFq78wdLaHJtgdqKjMvWLyZnJ-TzP1q71fnH7TM63ZHKuB1oPgecDC5DPqfItF4uVRyg-YeVQ4sWp5HxUHr1zATlCJV7z-5urcDE5N8W44_Qh-DqMTItXBB--U-hH_D5G_g8AAP__JjWIJw) on Iranian territory. ## Smokable Hemp Now Banned
New regulations restricting the sale of THC-infused hemp products go into effect today, effectively [banning the sale](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL-O5CAMh5-GdI7AMPlTUFyTbq-9MiLEGdAQPArsZuftTxndPcF2lmx__vz78zF_uJhivv92O9n6vfGc6SyJaqVjLj4wpxKYa8z3wJ-lcva804wSO5AatJpXF9NrNs1qF7mOqiGr-t6MNzMMXROsv2240EbKD9jh4MlLvC00KpTajCibaC-Y1FopJZUaWvS4qE113veIymzCSFpj5aOtgSp9u7KlF3_R0Xrem2RDrc8i9C-Bk8DpPM_Wp-gf-M_3mhI4XW8JnN77AqfrpsBJ6qs2_xtwxpRgcRnKzg9ySyIItD_Bu5zdEgtwht0dPoBWEOigAmdwFV78CZlohcrwyHwKnJrDrs-LF0vXCyPvu4vprVx_FvSXxb8BAAD__2mMkvA) of smokable hemp. The new rules were issued pursuant to an executive order from Gov. Greg Abbott, who [vetoed legislation](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLvS2yAUhJ8GdWjEQRdcUKRR57QpNVyOBAkSHji27LfPyK_wt7vz7ezun_tyNzHFY_ttdtT0XvNy4FkTEmFZqgs5pxpypnhsIT8r5cPlHRfoYOSd5FIs3sT0WfrGa9v5m2hQi2nqb0Ov1NgEPfjhhn40IL1EJZS01sO6wuSFWgelmqivsE5KIUQnhGrBgRWrGJ2bAES_sr5DHymXlgISvk1d0ye_sLQu703SgehRmfzFYGYwn-fZOluvFZfPYP4iDOZLYjDXPf8zNiEPuD84Bcd3U-LfpzkML7g9k6GYj8q_GN8KbtxYm4kYzE3R_nHGlGIdJ9Z3225i-tagn5330vA_AAD__4fyhso) to ban the sale of such products outright. They restrict purchases to customers age 21 or older, dramatically increase licensing fees for retailers, and revise the method of determining a product's THC concentration, which is limited to 0.3%. Now, THCA--a non-psychoactive cannabinoid in smokable hemp that converts to THC when heated--is included in THC concentration. Retailers have been trying to [clear their shelves](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO4yAYhJ8Gd1j-gRi7oEjj4qRce9I1FmAc0IKx4E-c7NOvnFfYbqSRPs03_27zTYcYtvtfnZzC15rnzR01OkRX5mp9zrH6nDFsd58fFfNmc3Iz61hPO045zIsO8T2LZlGmW0ZonAIpxXgRw9A3XjEGozHywkGY1faD5Hq0g-GgpTBc6CaoE9ZxDgAdwNAyywys0FsrGQOxEtG5JWAuLXqH7qXrGt_56Uprc2qi8oh7JfxK2ETYdBxHm-p2doRNbqOPSth0ShE2ffIHQTHT4iqWYJHWlL-0iY6it9S7tNO95OVhsdKKupzyNOliPeVA2KQLvV7h_x_-LZuilv0IMYbaSyK6e9Ihfnbh7958KvYTAAD__y-kiqM) of THCA products in recent weeks ahead of their effective ban. Boomtown Vapor, a vape shop chain based in Beaumont with several locations throughout the state, sued to [stop the new rules](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uozAUhJ8GOiP_YUPhYhu6bLslcsxxbK3hIHwIydtfJa9w-5nRfN-_23zzueTt8dev4OgVcd7gqgWI4JhrSIilJkTK2yPhWQm3gCvMkkvDuGJKzIvP5T3rdnF3voyiBSes1WOvh8G0yUFv-l5pPZgw6kEsVhorrY0-cj2OXrfZfca4UkIILsTQySDvIgoTgpVS6NhoDksmPDpKQPDyNZY3PuHoAq5tcYlor43608ipkdN1XV3El_Vnpbx9Io2cPkyNnL5llmDdWU24s3pCZfeC4T_b4GKE5AujFNhxFqisArHVHyExJdrDLfuVS8nV2Ebzx-pz-R6g32l7OvkTAAD__xp7gzI) earlier this month, claiming the Department of State Health Services doesn't have the unilateral authority to redefine how THC concentration is measured.

---
| | Friend,
---
This may be uncomfortable to hear.
But most political donations don’t change who wins elections.
They fund activity, not outcomes.
They pay for:
* TV ads that voters ignore
* Consultants who write memos
* Events that make insiders feel important

Meanwhile, elections are decided by something much more basic:
**➡️ Which side puts more paper in the ballot box.**
Charlie Kirk understood this before anyone.
In 2024, he deployed THOUSANDS of ballot-chasers to find and engage voters who hadn’t participated in recent elections.
His teams would follow up, visit, call, text...**__they did whatever it took__** to ensure voters banked their votes before Election Day.
He jokingly called his ballot-chasing operation “polite nagging.”
**Well, Charlie’s polite nagging won _big_.**
Republicans didn’t just win – they _swept_ – and Charlie’s ballot-chasing army delivered all 5 swing states for President Trump.
**[Now, we’re digging in ahead of Midterms and the Democrat’s billion dollar ground effort is already in overdrive. Will you stand with us right now?](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D)**
Turning Point PAC is funding a hiring surge: **700 _new_ full-time ballot-chasers** to join teams already deployed in key districts.
Each ballot-chaser has a clear operational target:
➡️ Find and identify voters and commit to banking **10 ballots a day** in the early voting periods
For this new class of 700 chasers, that adds up to:
* 7,000 votes per day
* 140,000+ votes in 20 days

**Those margins decide Congress.**
Don’t waste another dollar on strategies that feel good but don’t produce wins.
Fund logistics. Fund turnout. Fund ballot-chasing.
🟢 $50 → Sponsors **1 ballot-chaser** 🟢 $100 → Sponsors **2 ballot-chasers** 🟢 $250 → Powers a **targeted turnout team** 🟢 $500 → Funds a **major precinct push** 🟢 $1,000+ → **Maximum impact**
Invest in what works.

[CHIP IN](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D)

For Charlie,****
Tyler Bowyer
Executive DIrector
Turning Point PAC

Hey Peter, [Our first FEC fundraising report of 2026 is due Tuesday night.](https://cefuo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0019K7LYpubdK953CTnGLuaW-ZqpuQ-lUVrWRI4jQKmQfmN2LtLENU1qXN4IDS-t4DIQIMye5nW7nJfcp-VXhSX1kHyzhZOreNCediWn-gfZ-wwOrVLq9NVRVP7hZFozi51p4Spqo2mkpzKGQPEmIWGK1K3ukQLwI2a9gjXE5b_bIBACYnyqN-PKwCIqGhyrNM8KzWjytA4bV-y5GjTip4foxq1AP4E-1AttWdRRaO9Yo_cO5a3P_n81mAu-ppz7OXj2RaCUPcRPHDPUYw3bm4vGJcsw1BCvLmWKLcUoDaxJxM=&c=MbLtiNAL3Atw2pFKxzTJtavEUp__q7jsSBmqFY727nQCf77blD-P8Q==&ch=mmnBxkWd6AE1-jddf8ypE4-QJTFYrXEGf8I3W5kJaCEk-HXhErRjrQ==)
That's not an inside-baseball detail. It's a public document that political reporters, our opponent's campaign, and every organization that's been watching this race will have access to, showing exactly how much money we've raised over the last three months and how many people are behind us.
Here's why this matters so much right now:
On Friday, we beat a 30-year incumbent 158 to 77 at our district's assembly. Not because we outspent her, but because Denver Democrats looked at their congressperson's record - the corporate PAC money, the checks from Big Pharma and ICE contractors, 30 years of coasting in one of the most progressive districts in the country, and said: we can do better.
That win is turning heads, Peter, and now we're bracing for a flood of dark money that could be targeting our campaign. The health insurance industry? AIPAC? Billionaire tech bros?
We need to be ready if they come after us.
I know we can't out-raise them, but we can show them that the people are on our side.
[Will you chip in $5 or more before Tuesday night? Every donation helps us beat our opponent in individual donors - and builds the resources we need to win the June primary.](https://cefuo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0019K7LYpubdK953CTnGLuaW-ZqpuQ-lUVrWRI4jQKmQfmN2LtLENU1qXN4IDS-t4DIQIMye5nW7nJfcp-VXhSX1kHyzhZOreNCediWn-gfZ-wwOrVLq9NVRVP7hZFozi51p4Spqo2mkpzKGQPEmIWGK1K3ukQLwI2a9gjXE5b_bIBACYnyqN-PKwCIqGhyrNM8KzWjytA4bV-y5GjTip4foxq1AP4E-1AtyDPcBwAWcg0qOMwSrVleiKegMhIFLJSq8Rn6NSRXFmGhTBU4bwSsl4By5v-IVDR-k0sGraJsZqU=&c=MbLtiNAL3Atw2pFKxzTJtavEUp__q7jsSBmqFY727nQCf77blD-P8Q==&ch=mmnBxkWd6AE1-jddf8ypE4-QJTFYrXEGf8I3W5kJaCEk-HXhErRjrQ==)

I grew up in Denver watching my parents work two and three jobs just to keep us here. I know what healthcare costs and rent increases feel like in real life. That's why I'm in this race and why I won't take a dime from the corporate PACs that have kept my opponent in power for three decades.
[The FEC report is our chance to show the world that a grassroots campaign from Denver can take on the establishment and win.](https://cefuo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0019K7LYpubdK953CTnGLuaW-ZqpuQ-lUVrWRI4jQKmQfmN2LtLENU1qXN4IDS-t4DIQIMye5nW7nJfcp-VXhSX1kHyzhZOreNCediWn-gfZ-wwOrVLq9NVRVP7hZFozi51p4Spqo2mkpzKGQPEmIWGK1K3ukQLwI2a9gjXE5b_bIBACYnyqN-PKwCIqGhyrNM8KzWjytA4bV-y5GjTip4foxq1AP4E-1AtU2Ed7k-1m3b2pAcZbb3NvntGhtPzbWuHri5U1f4Sc1LtahVyGsMFbrY63zSLDrczKn8NV6TdCP0=&c=MbLtiNAL3Atw2pFKxzTJtavEUp__q7jsSBmqFY727nQCf77blD-P8Q==&ch=mmnBxkWd6AE1-jddf8ypE4-QJTFYrXEGf8I3W5kJaCEk-HXhErRjrQ==)

body:
I cannot do this alone, and this is your last chance to make a donation before this critical deadline.

Peter –
Today. Not tomorrow. Not next week.
Today is the day I need you to donate to my PAC, Fight for the People.
A few days ago, I announced my trips to North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, and Arkansas next month to speak out and raise money for Democrats before the midterm elections.
**[Right now, I am asking you to support that work by making a donation.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kdh-fftp-em?refcode=em260330-before&refcode2=1032_2563979_hqku6T&akid=1032%2E2563979%2Ehqku6T) Here’s why:
Tonight, our first end-of-quarter deadline of this critical midterm year comes to a close.
When tonight’s deadline passes, exactly how much the PAC has raised to fund this upcoming work will become public.
I’ve been a public figure long enough to know that everyone will be watching to see if I still have the grassroots support that has powered me through my career.
So what do you say, Peter? I am counting on your support today to show the Trump Administration and everyone else watching that we are ready to overwhelmingly elect leaders who will fight for the people this November.
**I cannot do this alone, and this is your last chance to make a donation before this critical deadline.**
**[Please make a $5 contribution, or whatever it is you can afford, directly to my PAC – Fight for the People PAC – before our first FEC fundraising deadline of this midterm election year ends at midnight tonight.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kdh-fftp-em?refcode=em260330-before&refcode2=1032_2563979_hqku6T&akid=1032%2E2563979%2Ehqku6T)

subject: up early

body:
thinking about what’s at stake
|
---
[ ](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/2092?t=1&akid=3505%2E52803%2EwsVkJP)
| | **Good morning, Peter!** I woke up early, so I wanted to take a minute to reach out with my thoughts before the day gets going. If you’re an early bird like me, I’m glad you’re here. (If not, I hope I didn’t wake you up). Lately, I’ve been thinking a lot about something Congressman John Lewis once said — that his greatest fear was waking up to a democracy gone. And right now, I have to be honest that I fear that too, because it feels closer than it should. In the Senate, I’ve been speaking out against the _SAVE Act_ because it does the exact opposite of what we should be doing. We should be expanding access to vote, not making it harder for people to participate in our democracy. At the same time, families are struggling to afford groceries, gas, and rent... and instead of addressing those challenges,**Republicans are tearing apart communities and dragging our economy down**. That’s not the leadership Marylanders, or Americans, deserve. I’m going to keep using my voice to fight back, protect voting rights, and stand up for working families. But I can’t do this alone — not with a FEC End-of-Quarter fundraising deadline just hours away. **[Will you chip in $10 or whatever you can this morning to help me keep up this fight and build the momentum we need to take back the Senate?](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/40441?t=9&amount=10&akid=3505%2E52803%2EwsVkJP)** | | | [Donate $10](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/40441?t=10&amount=10&akid=3505%2E52803%2EwsVkJP)

– Angela Alsobrooks

# Speak Out on Vaccine Discrimination
|
---
|
---
| **Let your voice be heard at the next Republican Party of Texas State Convention!** In true TFVC fashion, our exhibit hall presence will be bigger and stronger than ever, and a new, key part of **our booth is YOU!**
We’re inviting **healthcare workers and healthcare students** , including those in veterinary medicine & first responders, to **submit short videos** sharing any discrimination you’ve faced when applying for jobs or educational programs with a vaccine exemption. #
Peter, it’s Pete Buttigieg.
This specific moment in our nation’s history demands a lot from us. The principles that have guided us for the last 250 years are in jeopardy. With everything going on, it's not easy to know how you can make a real, meaningful impact.
But if you’re reading this, you know about VoteVets — and you’re well aware of the outsized impact they have on our politics. It’s an organization that, since its founding, has defended those very principles. They have worked relentlessly to elect leaders who will champion our democratic values, and will hold anyone who does not to account.
And it’s with all of that in mind that I write to you, and humbly ask: [**Will you join me in supporting VoteVets by making a donation to power their work?**](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-mar26.134TD_&refcode=em260331-1-120&t=1&akid=35043%2E3013755%2Ek8FbE7)

Thousands of leaders have been able to count on VoteVets over the years — including me. From races as local as school boards all the way to the presidency, they get Veterans the resources they need to win where it matters most. At a time when so much of our politics is a race to the bottom, VoteVets represents the very best we should hope for.
Their work does not stop with elections, though. VoteVets has been a stalwart defender of the Department of Veterans Affairs, their employees, and the Veterans who depend on them.
They played a pivotal role in getting the PACT Act passed in 2022. For decades, Veterans suffering from chronic illnesses because of toxic exposures during their time in uniform went without coverage. Far too many died as they waited for Congress to act. VoteVets changed that, and literally millions of Veterans are now eligible for care they desperately need.
With so much on the line in 2026, there are few organizations better suited to help lead us to the country we want the United States to be than VoteVets. They can’t do it alone, though.
I know many organizations and candidates are asking for your support, and I know you can’t help all of them. I just hope I’ve helped convince you that VoteVets has earned your support.
[**And if you’re willing to help, please: Make a donation to VoteVets ahead of their end-of-quarter FEC deadline on March 31st. #

Peter,
We’re just hours away from our critical FEC filing deadline. If you’re anything like me, you’ve probably gotten a lot of messages like this one asking for your support. And most will say the same thing: _this FEC deadline matters._
But here’s why it _really, really_ matters for this unique Senate race in Georgia, where I am the only Democratic incumbent Senator seeking reelection in a state Trump won:
1. **WE HAVE TO SHOW STRENGTH.** There are three Republican candidates running against me. And just last month, Trump stood on stage with one of them to rally their right-wing base, repeat conspiracy theories about the 2020 election, and personally attack me. That was just the beginning of Trump and MAGA’s mission to rally their base against me and defeat me. A strong showing on this FEC report is the only way to prove to them that our movement in Georgia is thriving and unstoppable.

2. **THERE’S NO TIME TO LOSE.** To win decisively, my team is already building a huge statewide campaign. That means more rallies. More organizers. More outreach — and early outreach — to voters in every corner of the state. That all takes resources right now. We’re building and we’ve got to keep building bigger and faster every day.

body:
We must prevent a disastrous slide into autocracy.
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128422237/611299708/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjgwNzAzNjkzLTAxMmQtZjExMS05YTQ4LTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wgkOryzo_SKJgHGniCg5WwaWeNJcUiAe29ySR7f8oRU=&emci=cc7a3275-fc29-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&emdi=80703693-012d-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&ceid=8431045)
---

**Peter, we have a matter of months to ensure we keep our democracy intact. ** President Donald Trump and his Republican enablers in Texas, North Carolina, and Missouri may have already stolen as many as seven congressional seats through unprecedented mid-decade redistricting. They are cheating, and they have shown us that they have no intention of stopping now. In Florida, Governor Ron DeSantis and his Republican legislature say they plan to help Republicans win up to five congressional seats. Ahead of November, more states could follow suit with extreme gerrymanders — this nationwide redistricting crisis is bound to get worse. Meanwhile, the Voting Rights Act is in peril at the U.S. Supreme Court. An upcoming decision could upend critical voting protections and deny equal representation for Black and brown communities across the country. We often hear about these redistricting fights as if it’s part of a conventional battle for control of the House of Representatives — but we must recognize that what is playing out in front of our eyes right now is more than that. **This is a fight to prevent our political system from sliding into autocracy.** Trump has already shown open disdain for our electoral process. He has no interest in protecting the will of the people. If we allow this White House to get another two years of unchecked power, we will see even more undemocratic schemes. If we do not stand up to the bully today, we are only inviting more abuse tomorrow. **Inaction at this moment is tantamount to surrender. ** Since founding the National Democratic Redistricting Committee in 2017, I have supported national redistricting reform — and that’s still our goal. clean_body: We must prevent a disastrous slide into autocracy. | Peter, we have a matter of months to ensure we keep our democracy intact. President Donald Trump and his Republican enablers in Texas, North Carolina, and Missouri may have already stolen as many as seven congressional seats through unprecedented mid-decade redistricting. They are cheating, and they have shown us that they have no intention of stopping now. In Florida, Governor Ron DeSantis and his Republican legislature say they plan to help Republicans win up to five congressional seats. Ahead of November, more states could follow suit with extreme gerrymanders — this nationwide redistricting crisis is bound to get worse. Meanwhile, the Voting Rights Act is in peril at the U.S. Supreme Court. An upcoming decision could upend critical voting protections and deny equal representation for Black and brown communities across the country. We often hear about these redistricting fights as if it’s part of a conventional battle for control of the House of Representatives — but we must recognize that what is playing out in front of our eyes right now is more than that. This is a fight to prevent our political system from sliding into autocracy. Trump has already shown open disdain for our electoral process. He has no interest in protecting the will of the people. If we allow this White House to get another two years of unchecked power, we will see even more undemocratic schemes. If we do not stand up to the bully today, we are only inviting more abuse tomorrow. Inaction at this moment is tantamount to surrender. Since founding the National Democratic Redistricting Committee in 2017, I have supported national redistricting reform — and that’s still our goal. While we’ve made significant progress, the present threats to our democracy mandate even more action to meet this moment. We must save our democracy now so that we can heal it in the future. As Frederick Douglass reminds us: “Power concedes nothing without a demand. It never did and it never will.” = With gratitude, Eric H. _Friends of the Bee,_ Ten years. That’s how long we’ve been competing with CNN for the top spot in funny fake news. That’s how long we’ve been trying to come up with jokes that are funnier than whatever Democrats are doing in real life. That’s how long we’ve been fighting for free speech against the censors. Ten years. It’s an improbable story. The Babylon Bee was born in March of 2016 without any funding or staff. It was just a good idea floating around in the mind of Adam Ford until he decided to make it a reality. He had no staff. No funding. No business model. Just a Wordpress template and a domain name – and a belief that bad ideas must be ridiculed. That was 2016. In the ten years since, the Bee has grown from a one-man operation into the most popular satire site in the world. We’ve published thousands of headlines. We’ve been fact-checked, smeared, and censored. We’ve testified before Congress and won victories in the courtroom. We’ve been invited onto the largest platforms to talk about our story. We’ve used the God-given gift of humor to speak truth into the culture, including the most important truth of all – that Jesus Christ is the savior of the world. And despite all the opposition we’ve faced, we’re still here ten years later.
---
[ **SUPPORT THE BEE** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e1010917/VaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjAzMzE/LbmNsTjdvSVg1bQ/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9QUVfV0FSUjk0NDExJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0xMF95ZWFycw/gacvKcg/s7n152e8f0f)

Some of you might remember when Twitter locked us out of our account for a joke we made about Rachel Levine. USA Today had named Levine, a man wearing a dress and makeup, their “Woman of the Year.” In response, we published an article naming Levine our pick for “Man of the Year.” Twitter called it “hateful conduct” and told us to delete the tweet. But they didn’t just want us to take it down. They wanted us to check a box saying we’d engaged in hateful conduct. They wanted us to lie and censor ourselves. We said no. We knew what that meant. Losing access to millions of followers. A huge chunk of our traffic and revenue, gone. But there are things you can’t put a price tag on, and the freedom to say what’s true is one of them. Elon Musk felt the same way. He bought Twitter and restored the Bee, which felt like a huge win until we handed him an IOU for $44 billion. But here’s what I really want you to know. None of this happened because we had funding from the outside. It all happened because of you. Our readers — [and especially our subscribers](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e1010917/VaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjAzMzE/LbmNsTjdvSVg1bQ/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9QUVfV0FSUjk0NDExJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0xMF95ZWFycw/gacvKcg/s7n152e8f0f) — are the reason the Bee exists today. When we lost our Twitter account, our subscribers kept the lights on. When advertisers backed away, our subscribers closed the gap. Every time someone tried to shut us down, it was our subscribers who made sure we could keep going. We don’t answer to investors. We don’t answer to advertisers. We answer only to you. That’s the way it should be, and it’s the only reason we’ve been able to take the costly stands that we have. Some of you haven’t been in a position to support us financially. That’s okay. We’d never ask you to do something you can’t afford. Leave that to your wives or Joel Osteen. But the rest of you can make a real difference. You can keep us in business for another decade. You can even help us pay down our debt to Elon Musk. This is your opportunity to buy our forgiveness for not subscribing sooner. So here’s my humble ask: **[Will you join us in the fight and become a paid subscriber](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e1010917/VaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjAzMzE/LbmNsTjdvSVg1bQ/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9QUVfV0FSUjk0NDExJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0xMF95ZWFycw/gacvKcg/s7n152e8f0f)[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e1010917/VaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjAzMzE/LbmNsTjdvSVg1bQ/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9QUVfV0FSUjk0NDExJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0xMF95ZWFycw/gacvKcg/s7n152e8f0f)**? If we’re going to make it another ten years, we need all the help we can get. And we won’t accept funding from anyone else – not even Israel. We’ve got big plans in the works. Movies and shows and books and more of the comedy that made you a fan in the first place. Ten years in, the mission hasn’t changed: tell the truth, make people laugh, and never apologize for any of it. Thanks for standing with us for a decade. [With your support](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e1010917/VaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjAzMzE/LbmNsTjdvSVg1bQ/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9QUVfV0FSUjk0NDExJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0xMF95ZWFycw/gacvKcg/s7n152e8f0f), the next will be even better.

clean_body: | | | Friends of the Bee, Ten years. That’s how long we’ve been competing with CNN for the top spot in funny fake news. That’s how long we’ve been trying to come up with jokes that are funnier than whatever Democrats are doing in real life. That’s how long we’ve been fighting for free speech against the censors. Ten years. It’s an improbable story. The Babylon Bee was born in March of 2016 without any funding or staff. It was just a good idea floating around in the mind of Adam Ford until he decided to make it a reality. He had no staff. No funding. No business model. Just a Wordpress template and a domain name – and a belief that bad ideas must be ridiculed. That was 2016. In the ten years since, the Bee has grown from a one-man operation into the most popular satire site in the world. We’ve published thousands of headlines. We’ve been fact-checked, smeared, and censored. We’ve testified before Congress and won victories in the courtroom. We’ve been invited onto the largest platforms to talk about our story. We’ve used the God-given gift of humor to speak truth into the culture, including the most important truth of all – that Jesus Christ is the savior of the world. And despite all the opposition we’ve faced, we’re still here ten years later. Some of you might remember when Twitter locked us out of our account for a joke we made about Rachel Levine. USA Today had named Levine, a man wearing a dress and makeup, their “Woman of the Year.” In response, we published an article naming Levine our pick for “Man of the Year.” Twitter called it “hateful conduct” and told us to delete the tweet. But they didn’t just want us to take it down. They wanted us to check a box saying we’d engaged in hateful conduct. They wanted us to lie and censor ourselves. We said no. We knew what that meant. Losing access to millions of followers. A huge chunk of our traffic and revenue, gone. But there are things you can’t put a price tag on, and the freedom to say what’s true is one of them. Elon Musk felt the same way. He bought Twitter and restored the Bee, which felt like a huge win until we handed him an IOU for $44 billion. But here’s what I really want you to know. None of this happened because we had funding from the outside. It all happened because of you. Our readers — — are the reason the Bee exists today. When we lost our Twitter account, our subscribers kept the lights on. When advertisers backed away, our subscribers closed the gap. Every time someone tried to shut us down, it was our subscribers who made sure we could keep going. We don’t answer to investors. We don’t answer to advertisers. We answer only to you. That’s the way it should be, and it’s the only reason we’ve been able to take the costly stands that we have. Some of you haven’t been in a position to support us financially. That’s okay. We’d never ask you to do something you can’t afford. Leave that to your wives or Joel Osteen. But the rest of you can make a real difference. You can keep us in business for another decade. You can even help us pay down our debt to Elon Musk. This is your opportunity to buy our forgiveness for not subscribing sooner. So here’s my humble ask: ? If we’re going to make it another ten years, we need all the help we can get. And we won’t accept funding from anyone else – not even Israel. We’ve got big plans in the works. Movies and shows and books and more of the comedy that made you a fan in the first place. Ten years in, the mission hasn’t changed: tell the truth, make people laugh, and never apologize for any of it. Thanks for standing with us for a decade. , the next will be even better. | | God bless you all, and long live The Babylon Bee. Hi there, Jimmy Kimmel here.
I know you’re used to seeing me on your TV screen, but today I’m reaching out to you about an important topic close to my heart: _ending America’s gun violence crisis._
Gun violence isn’t always in the headlines, and it can be far too easy for us to go about our daily lives and forget that it’s happening each and every day. But for the families who now have empty seats at their dinner table — like the families who lost a child in Newtown, Parkland, or Uvalde — they can never, ever forget.
**[GIFFORDS is doing lifesaving work at the forefront of the gun safety movement, and I'm proud to be an ambassador for this incredible organization. Will you join me in supporting GIFFORDS PAC by making a contribution to support their work before their critical end-of-quarter deadline?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q12026.IDrYd1&refcode=em260331-1-expansion&t=2&akid=11351%2E3935704%2EaegBGp)

Gun violence is a uniquely American epidemic. The leading cause of death for children in our nation is gun violence.
This is the only developed country in the world where this happens. We have to do something to change this.
Laws such as universal background checks, safe storage laws, and extreme risk protection orders would help ensure that guns can’t fall into the hands of people who shouldn’t have access to them. We call these laws common sense because that’s just what they are — common sense.
It is long past time for our representatives to do their job and truly represent the American people. The majority of Americans support commonsense gun safety legislation.
_**But instead, the Trump administration is focused on making guns even easier to buy and lining the pockets of his gun lobby allies._**
This is not a moment where we can sit back. We must be loud and use our collective voice to make a change. So please:

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE:** March 31, 2026**Contact:** ealbertson@fp1.com
**Houston, Texas** – This morning, Don Huffines endorsed Alex Mealer for Texas’ newly redrawn Ninth Congressional District.
**Huffines announced his support for Mealer saying,** “I’m proud to endorse Alex Mealer for TX-09. Alex is a good friend and a true America First patriot. Like me, Alex isn’t afraid to roll up her sleeves, get to work, and deliver results for Texas families. I have full confidence that Alex is the strongest choice for TX-09 and the last person the SWAMP wants to see in that seat. Alex is incorruptible. West Pointer, combat veteran with a strong background in business as a former oil and gas finance executive and small business owner in the Houston Ship Channel. She is a woman of faith, a mom, and a wife of more than 17 years. Alex will put Texas families first by being a strong voice for American jobs and Texas values.”
**After receiving the endorsement, Alex Mealer issued the following statement:**
“Don Huffines is a fierce advocate for taxpayers and synonymous with liberty, limited government and Texas values—I am honored to have his full support for TX-09. Just like Don, I will use my significant private sector experience to save taxpayers money. Congress desperately needs more business-minded members who know how to read financial statements and balance a budget—those are a couple of the many skills I bring to the table.”
Huffines joins President Donald Trump, Congressman Brian Babin, Congressman Jim Jordan, the National Border Patrol Council, Jim “Mattress Mack” McIngvale, Harris County Commissioner Tom Ramsey, and law enforcement all across Texas in backing Alex Mealer, who came in first in the TX-09 Republican Primary.

Donald Trump is only President because of the **OUTDATED, UNFAIR,** and **UNDEMOCRATIC** Electoral College.

Remember: Hillary Clinton won the popular vote in 2016 but her victory was overruled, _all because of the Electoral College._

**We’ll be blunt. It needs to go IMMEDIATELY!**

So, we’re launching an urgent poll for Democrats in your area to gauge support for the Electoral College. Here's the honest truth, team.
[ **The Electoral College is a 238-year-old antiquated system that NO LONGER serves the American people.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/73529?t=10&akid=24073%2E4449941%2EWlSviE)
BUT, Donald Trump and his MAGA Republicans know that they will never win another Presidential election if we get rid of the Electoral College!

All they care about is holding onto power and they will do whatever it takes to keep it – even if that means silencing voters...

[**Voting is an ESSENTIAL building block of our democracy and when its integrity is compromised, so is our Democracy.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/73529?t=11&akid=24073%2E4449941%2EWlSviE)

[**We need 9,382 more responses from your area before midnight in order to gauge support. If we don’t hit our goal, it will make it incredibly difficult to formulate our strategy moving forward. Your response is crucial.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/73529?t=12&akid=24073%2E4449941%2EWlSviE)

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. name: Tom Leonard
subject: March 31st - Positive Path Newsletter
body:
[](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/5V4YjqTNcZm892HZ7jqdBAfQ/ld763fgQzagrdSiM95AjHlqw)
---
Dear Friend,

Every week we are growing our coalition and meeting more people in more local communities around the state. As April kicks off this week, that mission continues to be so important. Our campaign is sharing The Path Forward for Michigan, one day, and one community at a time.

Here are some highlights of our work from this past week:
* I attended the MIGOP Endorsement Convention
* I was featured in an interview with MIRS News
* I attended a Fundraiser hosted by my friends, Casey and Anna O'Neill
* I Spoke at a solar project meeting in Richland
* I had a great lunch with the Bloomfield Republican Women's Club

---
Together, we are creating The Path Forward.
**Protecting Michigan 's Hunting Heritage**
Hunters are essential to Michigan, and their rights must be protected. Here's todays Policy Spotlight from our plan, The Path Forward ([which you can check out here](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/ISQchexAir8g5763G3nj3pmQ/ld763fgQzagrdSiM95AjHlqw)).

_The Problem:_
Michigan is one of the top five states for licensed hunters and fishermen. A recent study found that hunters and anglers contribute over $11.2 billion to our state's economy and are responsible for over 170,000 jobs. Hunters come from all walks of life and ages. Policies and regulations are often promoted that would burden Michigan's hunters and our state's hunting industry.

_My Solution:_
1. Preserve Public Hunting Access: With nearly 10 million acres-- approximately 25 to 30 percent of the state's total land area--available for hunting, this land must remain open and accessible to hunters. State- owned lands should never be cleared or repurposed to meet green energy mandates.
2. Repeal Harmful Zoning Policies: Recent zoning laws that threaten to convert thousands of acres of productive farmland and prime hunting land into solar panel arrays and wind turbine installations must be repealed without delay.
3. Appoint a Pro-Hunting DNR Director: Michigan's next Director of the Department of Natural Resources must be committed to promoting, fostering, and expanding the state's hunting heritage rather than impeding it.
4. Uphold Second Amendment Rights: Article 1, Section 6 of the Michigan Constitution states: "Every person has a right to keep and bear arms for the defense of himself and the state." As your next governor, I will vigorously defend this fundamental right for all Michigan citizens, beginning with the adoption of constitutional carry legislation.

**Join the Team!**

It's with your help that results come. We would love to have you join the team!

• Volunteer Today: Sign up for phone banking, door-knocking, events, or hosting a meet-and-greet in your community. Your time makes all the difference! [Sign Up Here](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/8I9RgqGS8cvVcBqQ1H5BIQ/ld763fgQzagrdSiM95AjHlqw) and reach out to our Field Director, Tony, for more volunteer opportunities at [tony@tomformichigan.com](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/k8aNw763uEOQ8yFS3rLj2JVA/ld763fgQzagrdSiM95AjHlqw)

• Continue sharing our positive vision on social media - follow my X account's, [@Tom4Michigan](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/aJ7631dryR09ShC9llTyvWPQ/ld763fgQzagrdSiM95AjHlqw) and [@TomLeonard28](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/tWVjVy6RQYeb1Qal20PyEw/ld763fgQzagrdSiM95AjHlqw), my [Facebook page](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/a892tfyXbnJLsWImjhLRKdRg/ld763fgQzagrdSiM95AjHlqw), my [Instagram](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/m1A6UWEiiR50IfopsjzLqQ/ld763fgQzagrdSiM95AjHlqw), and my [TikTok](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/NAxUzAb1HOJVrqnmeGOgQg/ld763fgQzagrdSiM95AjHlqw).
---
Thank you for your continued support of our vision, and helping us share our Path Forward for Michigan across the state. Let's keep the momentum going and start April strong!
---

God bless you and your loved ones. Have a great week.

Best,

**Tom Leonard**
Candidate for Governor
To learn more, get involved, and donate visit [www.TomForMichigan.com](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/GIeqgymB4e87T8928LvW4GWw/ld763fgQzagrdSiM95AjHlqw)

body:
Midnight tonight| | | _Folks,_ _Our end-of-quarter deadline comes to a close_** _at midnight_** _, and let me just say—right now, our amount raised is not yet at goal._ _My team has reached out to you a few times now with no response._ _I am going to ask one more time for your support, and I understand that for some of you, you would love to help, but you are simply not able. And that is okay._ _However, before this deadline hits tonight, I want to reiterate a few important points:_
1. _The Republican majority in Congress is razor-thin. If Democrats flip just a handful of seats like this one, they take control._
2. _Our elections here are decided by razor-thin margins. Every cycle, this district ranks among the closest races in the entire country._

My team has reached out to you a few times now with no response. I am going to ask one more time for your support, and I understand that for some of you, you would love to help, but you are simply not able. And that is okay. Peter,
My first major FEC fundraising deadline since a billionaire-backed opponent entered this race is tonight .
And what we report at midnight will shape everything that comes next.
Billionaires and corporate PACs are watching these numbers closely.
They want to see if they can overwhelm this campaign early.
So this moment matters.
I’m asking: will you chip in $1, $10, or whatever you can before the deadline? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-fund?refcode=20260331-eoq-2] Because right now, the number of people who give is just as important as the total raised.
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-fund?refcode=20260331-eoq-2]
Let me explain what’s happening.
I worked with Bernie Sanders to introduce a Billionaire Tax: a modest tax so the wealthiest pay their fair share to fund healthcare, housing, and education.
Now, the backlash is here.
A flood of outside money is pouring into this race from the same ultra-wealthy networks that try to buy elections across the country.
Political analysts are already calling this the toughest race I’ve faced.
But here’s what they don’t understand: This campaign isn’t powered by billionaires. It’s powered by people.
I don’t take corporate PAC money.
I don’t take checks from lobbyists.
And I’m not going to start now.

In solidarity,
Ro

Hi there,
After serving our country for 35 years in the Navy, I was removed from my position by Pete Hegseth without reason.
I spent my entire life in service to this country, always putting the mission and the people above myself. But when I was forced out, I had a choice: go out quietly, or find a way to keep serving.
I’ve always lived by three simple ideals: honor, integrity, and respect. That’s why I’m running for Congress in South Carolina’s first district. If you believe that’s what we need in Washington right now, please consider splitting $20 between my campaign and Resist Reclaim Rebuild? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-lacore]
BECOME A FOUNDING DONOR TO MY CAMPAIGN TODAY! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-lacore]
The day I was removed from my position, I was forced to leave behind my life’s work. I never went back to the Pentagon or wore the uniform again.
But this story isn’t just about me. Throughout the first year of Donald Trump’s second term, every woman serving as a three or four-star admiral in the Navy has been fired, forced out, or reassigned. This wasn’t an isolated incident. It’s a pattern.
When leadership decisions are driven by politics instead of integrity, our families, communities, and nation pay the price.
That’s why I’m running for Congress: to keep serving, to stand up when it’s hardest, and to fight for leadership that puts country over politics every time.
Early support in races like this matters most. We have a long road ahead of us if we’re going to fill this open seat and make the government work for the people again. If you can, please split $20 between my campaign and Resist Reclaim Rebuild to help me hit the ground running and prove that service to our country shouldn’t end just because someone in power says it should. Nancy Lacore

### Resurrection & Renewal: Easter in America
---
| |
---
| | As Easter approaches, we reflect on the deeper meaning of the season and why it continues to resonate with so many today. From the traditions of Holy Week to the enduring message of hope and renewal, this conversation explores themes of faith, purpose, and spiritual rebirth—alongside a renewed appreciation for America’s founding ideals of faith and freedom. This week’s episode features Bishop Leon Benjamin, pastor and founder of New Life Harvest Church and a national faith leader. He shares perspectives on the role of faith in today’s culture, the significance of Israel in the biblical narrative, and what he views as a growing spiritual revival across the country—particularly among families seeking a stronger foundation. ### How to Turn Up Your Family's Celebration This Year
---
| |
---
| | There’s something about the way we celebrate in America. We go big—full of color, creativity, and flair. Others may say we overdo it, but that’s just how we roll in the land of the free, home of the brave. From massive parade balloons to over-the-top holiday decorations, we embrace the bold and festive without apology. It’s part of our cultural heritage—our signature approach. The American way. Easter, like many of our holidays, blends the sacred with celebration—bringing together faith, family, and the remembrance of our Savior’s victory over death. The ultimate success story. We’re sharing a few simple ideas to help you turn up both the fun and the meaning in your family’s celebration this year. Read the full blog by joining our free membership at Moms TownSquare.

| **A Personal Message on Leadership and the Future of Our Community**
Peter,

I don’t lend my name lightly—and I certainly don’t speak up without purpose.

After thoughtful consideration and close observation, I am proud to offer my support to Charlotte Bergmann in her campaign for Congress.

Throughout my career—both in the courtroom and in the public arena—I have stood firmly for justice, accountability, and the rule of law. I know what real leadership looks like, and I know when it is absent. What I see in Charlotte Bergmann is a candidate who understands the urgency of this moment and is prepared to lead with strength, clarity, and conviction.

Our communities are facing serious challenges: concerns about public safety, economic pressure on working families, and a growing belief that leadership has become disconnected from the people it serves. Charlotte is not disconnected. She listens. She shows up. She is committed to delivering results—not excuses.

I am asking those who care about the direction of our community to stand with Charlotte Bergmann.

Support her campaign.
• Invest in her vision.
• Help ensure we send leadership to Washington that reflects our values and expectations.

body:
They funded everything except the people keeping us safe.

---](https://ericburlisonforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b6500a115da3c4344522b1e48&id=b44cba4709&e=5f9dc01b8c)
| | Peter ,
I should have been home this weekend. It was supposed to be the start of Easter break. Instead, I was standing in the Capitol on a Friday night because the United States Senate betrayed the men and women who keep this country safe.Here's what happened. The Senate had been debating the Save America Act. They should have kept fighting. They should have pressed the Democrats to the brink and passed something meaningful. Instead, they gave up.At midnight, they passed a funding bill that pays for everything in the federal government except ICE agents, Customs and Border Patrol agents, and HSI, which is the division of ICE that investigates child sex trafficking in the United States.Read that again. They defunded the team that fights child trafficking.Then they left town. Packed up and went home for Easter break while the people protecting our borders still don't know when their next paycheck is coming.I stayed. So did the Speaker and members of the Freedom Caucus. We're not accepting this. We're sending it back.Thank you for standing with me,

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.
